title: Noise stability bounded by bivariate stability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0<\rho<1$, and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be measurable with $0\le f(x)\le1$ for every $x$. Its Gaussian noise stability is at most the expectation of the bivariate Gaussian stability at the pair of values $(f(X),f(Y))$, where $(X,Y)$ has the correlated Gaussian measure with coordinate correlation $\rho$.
